genxml.title: Analog Devices AD1843 stereo codec: the 29 internal registers
genxml.from: Analog Devices AD1843 Serial-Port 16-Bit SoundComm Codec, REV.0 (1996): register pages 28-50 and the register summary on page 52. The PDF is not stored in this repository, so these values were not re-checked against it here.
genxml.doc: The AD1843 serial-port codec used by the O2 MACE audio interface. Register numbers are the codec's own, not MACE byte offsets, and are reached through the MACE codec command register (mace_audio.toml, codec_cmd). Each register is 16 bits. Field masks follow the published register table; bits the table does not define are not listed.

struct.name: STATUS_ID
struct.from: Analog Devices AD1843 Serial-Port 16-Bit SoundComm Codec, REV.0 (1996): register pages 28-50 and the register summary on page 52. The PDF is not stored in this repository, so these values were not re-checked against it here.
struct.doc: INIT, the converter power-down state and the silicon revision. Reset sets INIT and power-down, so the codec starts in initialisation. The revision field is read-only and resets to 1, the first-silicon value in the table; the revision of a fitted part is not measured here (established, register pages 28-50 and summary page 52).

struct.name: UNDERRUN_PEAK
struct.from: Analog Devices AD1843 Serial-Port 16-Bit SoundComm Codec, REV.0 (1996): register pages 28-50 and the register summary on page 52. The PDF is not stored in this repository, so these values were not re-checked against it here.
struct.doc: DAC underrun flags and the peak level of each ADC channel. A read returns the status and clears all of it. Any write clears all of it too, so this register is not write-one-to-clear (established, register pages 28-50).

struct.name: ADC_INPUT
struct.from: Analog Devices AD1843 Serial-Port 16-Bit SoundComm Codec, REV.0 (1996): register pages 28-50 and the register summary on page 52. The PDF is not stored in this repository, so these values were not re-checked against it here.
struct.doc: Analog source, microphone boost and gain for each ADC channel. The gain steps are 1.5 dB per code and the microphone boost adds 20 dB (established, register pages 28-50 and the routing text).

struct.name: DAC2_TO_DAC1_MIX
struct.from: Analog Devices AD1843 Serial-Port 16-Bit SoundComm Codec, REV.0 (1996): register pages 28-50 and the register summary on page 52. The PDF is not stored in this repository, so these values were not re-checked against it here.
struct.doc: Analog mix of DAC2 into the DAC1 output. Page 53 identifies the register as DAC2-to-DAC1 mixing; the summary's own names for it differ (inferred). Gain is 12 minus 1.5 times the code, in dB. The mute bits are separate from the gain.

struct.doc: Analog mix of the AUX1 input. Same layout and gain law as dac2_to_dac1_mix (established, register pages 28-50).

struct.doc: Analog mix of the AUX2 input. Same layout and gain law as dac2_to_dac1_mix (established, register pages 28-50).

struct.name: AUX3_MIX
struct.from: Analog Devices AD1843 Serial-Port 16-Bit SoundComm Codec, REV.0 (1996): register pages 28-50 and the register summary on page 52. The PDF is not stored in this repository, so these values were not re-checked against it here.
struct.doc: Analog mix of the AUX3 input. Same layout and gain law as dac2_to_dac1_mix (established, register pages 28-50).

struct.name: MIC_MIX
struct.from: Analog Devices AD1843 Serial-Port 16-Bit SoundComm Codec, REV.0 (1996): register pages 28-50 and the register summary on page 52. The PDF is not stored in this repository, so these values were not re-checked against it here.
struct.doc: Analog mix of the microphone input. Same layout and gain law as dac2_to_dac1_mix (established, register pages 28-50).

struct.name: MONO_CONTROL
struct.from: Analog Devices AD1843 Serial-Port 16-Bit SoundComm Codec, REV.0 (1996): register pages 28-50 and the register summary on page 52. The PDF is not stored in this repository, so these values were not re-checked against it here.
struct.doc: Mono mix gain and mute in the upper byte. The lower byte holds the all-mix mute, the mono and headphone mutes, the output swing, the sum mute and the gain-change timing of each DAC (established, register page 33). The all-mix mute is read from the detailed diagram as covering the DAC2, AUX1 to AUX3 and microphone analog contributions only (inferred). The prose describes it more broadly, and the two readings conflict (see docs/mace-audio.md).

struct.name: DAC1_OUTPUT
struct.from: Analog Devices AD1843 Serial-Port 16-Bit SoundComm Codec, REV.0 (1996): register pages 28-50 and the register summary on page 52. The PDF is not stored in this repository, so these values were not re-checked against it here.
struct.doc: DAC1 output gain and mute, left and right. Gain is six bits, mute is separate. Resets muted (established, register pages 28-50).

struct.name: DAC2_OUTPUT
struct.from: Analog Devices AD1843 Serial-Port 16-Bit SoundComm Codec, REV.0 (1996): register pages 28-50 and the register summary on page 52. The PDF is not stored in this repository, so these values were not re-checked against it here.
struct.doc: DAC2 output gain and mute, left and right. Same layout as dac1_output. Gain and mute here control the separate DAC2 output branch. The DAC2 contribution into the DAC1 mix is taken before this gain (inferred from the routing diagram, page 53).

struct.name: DAC1_DIGITAL_ATT
struct.from: Analog Devices AD1843 Serial-Port 16-Bit SoundComm Codec, REV.0 (1996): register pages 28-50 and the register summary on page 52. The PDF is not stored in this repository, so these values were not re-checked against it here.
struct.doc: DAC1 digital attenuation and mute, left and right. Attenuation is 1.5 dB per code and code 63 is finite attenuation, not mute (established, register pages 28-50 and the routing text).

struct.name: DAC2_DIGITAL_ATT
struct.from: Analog Devices AD1843 Serial-Port 16-Bit SoundComm Codec, REV.0 (1996): register pages 28-50 and the register summary on page 52. The PDF is not stored in this repository, so these values were not re-checked against it here.
struct.doc: DAC2 digital attenuation and mute, left and right. Same layout and law as dac1_digital_att (established, register pages 28-50).

struct.name: ADC_TO_DAC1_MIX
struct.from: Analog Devices AD1843 Serial-Port 16-Bit SoundComm Codec, REV.0 (1996): register pages 28-50 and the register summary on page 52. The PDF is not stored in this repository, so these values were not re-checked against it here.
struct.doc: Digital mix of the ADC data into DAC1, attenuation and mute per channel. Code 63 is full mute here, unlike the ordinary DAC attenuator (established, register pages 28-50 and the routing text).

struct.name: ADC_TO_DAC2_MIX
struct.from: Analog Devices AD1843 Serial-Port 16-Bit SoundComm Codec, REV.0 (1996): register pages 28-50 and the register summary on page 52. The PDF is not stored in this repository, so these values were not re-checked against it here.
struct.doc: Digital mix of the ADC data into DAC2. Same layout and code-63 rule as adc_to_dac1_mix (established, register pages 28-50).

struct.name: CLOCK_SELECT
struct.from: Analog Devices AD1843 Serial-Port 16-Bit SoundComm Codec, REV.0 (1996): register pages 28-50 and the register summary on page 52. The PDF is not stored in this repository, so these values were not re-checked against it here.
struct.doc: Sample-rate source of each DAC and ADC: 0 is the fixed 48 kHz clock and 1 to 3 are generators 1 to 3. The published table lists code 1 twice for the ADC selectors. Page 53 reads the right ADC code 2 as clock 2, as for the other three selectors (inferred).

struct.name: CLOCK1_MODE
struct.from: Analog Devices AD1843 Serial-Port 16-Bit SoundComm Codec, REV.0 (1996): register pages 28-50 and the register summary on page 52. The PDF is not stored in this repository, so these values were not re-checked against it here.
struct.doc: Mode of generator 1. Clock 2 and clock 3 use the same layout at registers 19 and 22. Bits 9 and 8 are not defined (established, register pages 38 to 43).

struct.name: CLOCK1_HZ
struct.from: Analog Devices AD1843 Serial-Port 16-Bit SoundComm Codec, REV.0 (1996): register pages 28-50 and the register summary on page 52. The PDF is not stored in this repository, so these values were not re-checked against it here.
struct.doc: Nominal rate of generator 1 in Hz. Reset is 48000 (established, register pages 28-50). Clock 2 and clock 3 use registers 20 and 23.

struct.name: CLOCK1_PHASE
struct.from: Analog Devices AD1843 Serial-Port 16-Bit SoundComm Codec, REV.0 (1996): register pages 28-50 and the register summary on page 52. The PDF is not stored in this repository, so these values were not re-checked against it here.
struct.doc: Phase work for generator 1. A write replaces the remaining work. Units are 1/3000 of a conversion cycle (0.12 degrees). Direction 0 advances the phase and 1 retards it. Clock 2 and clock 3 use registers 21 and 24 (established, register pages 39, 42 and 45, and the phase section).

struct.from: Analog Devices AD1843 Serial-Port 16-Bit SoundComm Codec, REV.0 (1996): register pages 28-50 and the register summary on page 52. The PDF is not stored in this repository, so these values were not re-checked against it here.
struct.doc: Mode of generator 2, same layout and reset as clock1_mode (established, register pages 38 to 43). The source notes that a description citing registers 17 and 18 for clock 2 means 20 and 21 (inferred).

struct.name: DIGITAL_FILTER
struct.from: Analog Devices AD1843 Serial-Port 16-Bit SoundComm Codec, REV.0 (1996): register pages 28-50 and the register summary on page 52. The PDF is not stored in this repository, so these values were not re-checked against it here.
struct.doc: Digital ADC source, resample filter and DAC mix mode. The resample filter and DAC mix mode change only while the converters they affect are off (established, register pages 28-50 and the constraints text).

struct.name: FORMAT_LOCK
struct.from: Analog Devices AD1843 Serial-Port 16-Bit SoundComm Codec, REV.0 (1996): register pages 28-50 and the register summary on page 52. The PDF is not stored in this repository, so these values were not re-checked against it here.
struct.doc: Sample format, mono mode, the frame-rate and SDFS options and the ADC lock. Bits 7 to 5 are the SCF, FRS and FRST controls (established, register pages 28-50 and the serial-frame section).

struct.name: ENABLES
struct.from: Analog Devices AD1843 Serial-Port 16-Bit SoundComm Codec, REV.0 (1996): register pages 28-50 and the register summary on page 52. The PDF is not stored in this repository, so these values were not re-checked against it here.
struct.doc: Power and enable bits for the converters, ADCs, analog paths and headphone output. Registers 1 to 15, 25 and 27 are held at reset while converter power-down is set (established, register pages 28-50).

struct.name: POWER_CLOCK
struct.from: Analog Devices AD1843 Serial-Port 16-Bit SoundComm Codec, REV.0 (1996): register pages 28-50 and the register summary on page 52. The PDF is not stored in this repository, so these values were not re-checked against it here.
struct.doc: Converter power, auto-calibration, generator enables, clock output and the line input modes. Bit 15 is PDNI, which resets to 1. Clearing it starts converter startup. Auto-calibration cannot be cleared before the first completed startup (established, register pages 28-50 and the initialisation text).
